title: EU Artificial Intelligence Act enters into force
summary: The Act took effect on 1 August 2024, 20 days after its publication in the Official Journal.

title: G42 relaunches Inception with a family of 20 open-source Jais models, trade press reports
summary: Wikipedia cites Middle East AI News for the relaunch of Inception with the Jais model family.

title: Reports say a glitch made Waymo driverless cars honk repeatedly overnight in San Francisco
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports of Waymo vehicles honking regularly through the night.

title: xAI makes Grok-2 available to X Premium subscribers, its first Grok model with image generation
summary: Grok-2 reached X Premium subscribers on 14 August 2024.

title: Reports say Grok generated offensive and violent images without proper safeguards
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports of Grok image outputs with few restrictions.

title: AMD announces a planned USD 4.9 billion acquisition of server builder ZT Systems
summary: The newsletter lists the planned acquisition among August 2024 AI hardware deals without giving a day.

title: Google agrees a deal with Character.AI that buys out investors at 2.5 times their Series A valuation, newsletter reports
summary: The newsletter describes the arrangement as Google acquiring or licensing Character.AI.

title: Nvidia reports Q2 revenue more than doubled year on year and reassures analysts on Blackwell timing
summary: The newsletter lists the results among August 2024 developments without giving a day.

title: UK government cuts GBP 1.3 billion of funding for the AI Research Resource and first exascale project, newsletter reports
summary: The newsletter lists the cut among August 2024 developments without giving a day.

title: Reports say Microsoft Copilot falsely accused journalist Martin Bernklau of crimes
summary: Copilot reportedly attributed crimes to Bernklau that he did not commit.

title: Donald Trump shares AI-generated images falsely suggesting Taylor Swift endorsed him
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the posting of AI-generated images that suggested a Swift endorsement.

title: Trailer for the film Megalopolis includes fake AI-generated quotes attributed to film critics
summary: The trailer carried invented critic quotes that were reportedly generated with AI.

title: A soldier at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson faces allegations of using AI to generate child sexual abuse material
summary: The case is reported as an allegation and has not been described as decided.

title: California Assembly passes SB 1047, a safety bill for large AI models, 48 to 16
summary: The Senate voted again the next day on the amended text and passed it 30 to 9.

title: Activists urge a national emergency declaration over deepfake pornography in South Korea, BBC reports
summary: Deepfake images of teachers and female students had surfaced in Telegram chats earlier in August.

title: Reuters reports an environmental group says xAI runs gas turbines without permits at its Memphis data centre
summary: The claim comes from an environmental group and was relayed by Reuters on 28 August 2024.

title: Japan's government holds first meeting of its AI Institutional Study Group on whether to legislate AI; PM Kishida sets four principles
summary: Jiji Press reports the group, chaired by Yutaka Matsuo and meeting with the AI Strategy Council, began examining rules for generative AI developers, including whether new laws are needed.

title: Chequeado reports President Milei says Argentina aims to be one of four global AI hubs under a low-regulation scheme
summary: The fact-checker reports Milei and adviser Demian Reidel pitch cheap energy, cold climate and the RIGI investment regime to attract AI data centres, contrasting their approach with EU regulation.

title: China's Cyberspace Administration says more than 180 generative AI models have completed state filing, with over 564 million registered users
summary: CAC deputy director Wang Jingtao gave the figures at the 12th Internet Security Conference, IT Home reports.

title: Tokyo start-up Sakana AI releases open-source 'AI Scientist' that automates idea generation, experiments, paper writing and review
summary: Developed with Oxford and University of British Columbia researchers, the system's source code is published on GitHub, Gigazine reports.
